Jeremiah 31:39 speaks of a measuring line going out over Jerusalem. Zechariah 1:16 twice mentions a line stretched over Jerusalem in restoration—the builder's cord marking future expansion. The term belongs to construction and surveying vocabulary, representing hope and rebuilding in prophetic texts."
